Original optimizer environment, full precision, success, termination, Jacobian and evaluation count were unavailable.
Original convergence, global optimality and exact optimizer replay were not established.
Direct14 fit quality did not identify host/phase allocation or thermal/kinetic parameters.
BIC was only a same-objective working statistic for smoothed correlated residuals.
Five float64 hashes were declared for voltage, observation, vector, prediction and residual.
RT/(Fw) is broadening rather than electron stoichiometry; separate z and rederive the reduced entropy-production expression.
Reversible-heat sign prose conflicted with the formula; retain -IT dU/dT under stated convention while control-volume allocation stays open.
Charging reverses signed trajectory, not state orientation; signed storage, metastability and the heat proof require rederivation.
The small-tail coefficient and dimensions were wrong; chemical and observation baselines and inadmissible denominators must be separated.
Fixed-state OCV differentiation includes w-prime logit(xi); a canonical entropy basis or rederivation is required.
Preserve raw network entropy production with capacity/rate/heat conditions and rebuild Chapter 4 as integrated EOS/DAE.
The alpha-skew observation map must remain empirical and isolated from signed storage, physical occupancy, heat and direction claims.
Normalized kernel measure and amplitude-bearing residual spectrum must be separated into a(L), Theta, K and b(L).
The thermal mirror mixed power and q-derivative; only a qualitative exp(-2dq/L) flag survived pending rederivation.
The shipped host preset was not the accepted generic Direct14 fit; model identity and objective differences forbid equating them.
The threshold derivative-divergence claim omitted leading-mass cancellation; area/continuity survive while divergence wording is removed and theory-only status remains.
Keyless width uses RT/F while dwdT and reported entropy are zero.
Hour-based C-rate and SI-second Eyring prefactor create an approximately 3600-fold lag-scale mismatch.
The multi-temperature correction is -R ln(3600) in entropy/intercept; 20.298 kJ/mol is only a 298.15 K apparent offset.
Eager np.where logistic evaluation emitted two overflow and one invalid-divide warning despite finite output.
Voltage sorting destroys nonmonotonic acquisition history and needs a separate time-ordered trajectory route.
Variable temperature is only partly pointwise because branch shift and lag use mean temperature.
Finite 5L padding leaves exp(-5) residual and duplicate initial voltage can yield zero padding points.
Default Si transitions could bypass invalid si_case validation.
The transition toggle changes future-instance global defaults but did not prove a stale mismatch inside existing instances.
Global R/F rebinding changes existing-object calculations while cached seed state remains stale.
Constants and transition choices should become explicit immutable profiles.
Inline documentation reversed default/opt-in and alpha-presence status.
The claimed five exact alpha upper-bound hits conflicted with stored maximum 7.99623012; active-set status remained unknown.
Terminal I(Uoc-V) heat exists, so a blanket not-implemented statement was false.
That heat path remained partial without sign/domain/control-volume or double-count guards.
The lineage also recorded nonfinite lag falling back silently to equilibrium.
